description: This Java class handles HL7 ADT A28 messages within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It processes patient registration or update events, parses HL7 segments, manages patient identifiers, and creates new patient records in the system based on HL7 message content.

classes.name: ADTA28Handler
classes.description: A handler class implementing the Application interface to process HL7 ADT A28 messages, creating or updating patient records accordingly.

methods.name: canProcess
methods.description: Checks if the message is an ADT A28 message and can be processed by this handler.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Main entry point for processing an HL7 message of type ADT A28.

methods.name: processADT_A28
methods.description: Handles the core logic of processing an ADT A28 message, including patient creation.

methods.name: findPatientId
methods.description: Resolves patient ID from PID segment.

methods.name: createPatient
methods.description: Creates a new Patient object from PID segment data and saves it in the system.

methods.name: getMSH
methods.description: Retrieves the MSH segment from the message.

methods.name: getPID
methods.description: Retrieves the PID segment from the message.

methods.name: tsToDate
methods.description: Converts a TS HL7 datatype to a Java Date object.
